name: mcode_clone
description: Clone a git repo into the workspace at /workspace/app using the connected GitHub App (a short-lived token is minted per call — never stored). Pass repo_full_name (owner/repo) and optional branch, or omit to use the workspace's recorded repo/branch. Replaces whatever is in /workspace/app. Returns { output, exit_code, ok }. Requires write scope + a ready workspace.

repo_full_name.description: owner/repo to clone; omit to use the workspace's repo.

branch.description: Branch to check out; omit for the repo default.
